# ENY Consulting

> ENY Consulting is a global business technology and consulting firm supporting organizations with digital transformation, AI strategy, business analysis, change management, and workforce development.

ENY Consulting serves organizations and professionals in Canada, the United States, Nigeria, and Ghana. Its headquarters are in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://enyconsulting.ca/): Company overview and featured work.
- [About ENY Consulting](https://enyconsulting.ca/about): Company background, mission, and expertise.
- [Consulting services](https://enyconsulting.ca/services): Business and technology consulting, recruitment and placement, coaching and training, and certifications.
- [Industries](https://enyconsulting.ca/industries): Sectors served by ENY Consulting.
- [Government solutions](https://enyconsulting.ca/government): Government workforce development, AI readiness, and digital transformation.
- [Case studies](https://enyconsulting.ca/case-studies): Selected consulting projects and outcomes.
- [Founder](https://enyconsulting.ca/founder): Information about ENY Consulting founder Eno Eka.
- [Contact](https://enyconsulting.ca/contact): Inquiries about consulting, partnerships, training, speaking, and media.
